author: The Linux Foundation
description: Paul E. McKenney, Software Engineer at Meta, and Shuah Khan will talk about Paul's experience as a kernel developer and maintainer, taking questions from the attendees. Paul will share what works and what doesn’t for him and strategies, interpersonal and technical skills and mindset that help him stay engaged for a longer term.
title: My Life as a Linux Kernel Developer and Maintainer with Paul E. McKenney
